notes.title: Major Update
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302262/a7eb86d0cb25bff85046023c818d6b14148ba8d4.png"][/img][/p][h3][/h3][h3]Just wanted to update this Steam demo, it's been awhile and there have been a lot of changes/improvements i've added to the asset. Here are some of the main changes:[/h3][list][*][p]Gun Kick feature.[/p][/*][*][p]Added unique Kick patterns for all weapons.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Zombie Mode Gun Purchasables are now randomized.[/p][/*][*][p]Dual Render Scopes.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Improvements to Reticle Depth.[/p][/*][*][p]New Thermal Sight + Effect with heat signatures.[/p][/*][*][p]New Sensitivity Training category which allows adjustments to Magnification on the fly to compatible sight attachments[/p][/*][*][p]New gun preset for each gun including external assets to include new Thermal Sight attachment.[/p][/*][*][p]Slowed down default ADS Speed of TSR-9, UZ-X and MPK.[/p][/*][*][p]New reticles for ACOG and Thermal sights.[/p][/*][*][p]Fists weapon slot.[/p][/*][*][p]Revamped Empty Lot to test destruction.[/p][/*][/list][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302262/c60119bf563b5dc56c4e76cc9ee3f9a1a63b3c65.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302262/69a43d45e8587443086a4873c4f6daf815f7786c.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302262/148203d474578848c168184860b833663ea8a8e6.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302262/903a6d815d4744bc121cba0e29d5490dcfde6d49.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302262/f0236bdbc61fd65adb47c225ab868fc5cc5d8421.jpg"][/img][/carousel]

notes.title: Update notes
notes.content:
I haven't checked on this in awhile and to my surprise the reviews are "Very Positive". I figured I'd update this with all the improvements/content I've made since the last build if people are enjoying this little demo/showcase.

[h2]Update Features[/h2]

[list]
[*]Transition from UE4 to UE5
[*]Overhauled Animations
[*]More Guns
[*]Team Deathmatch with bots
[*]Scoreboard
[*]Retextured Weapons
[*]New Soldier/Zombie models
[*]New Hand/Arm models
[*]Shooting Range
[/list]

Enjoy!
